user.title: Set up Amazon
user.description: Choose the Amazon country you shop on. Parcels are read from your signed-in account for that country. To follow another country or another Amazon account, add the integration again. On Amazon storefronts in languages other than English, some status texts are still being collected. If the log shows an "Unrecognised Amazon status" warning, reporting it through the link in that warning helps.

sign_in.title: Sign in to Amazon
sign_in.description:
1. Open [the Amazon sign-in page for {country}]({sign_in_url}) in your own browser. It is Amazon's sign-in for the Alexa app. That is expected: Home Assistant signs in as an Alexa device, so it gets a lasting sign-in without ever seeing your password.
2. Sign in and complete any verification Amazon asks for.
3. You end up on a page whose address starts with `{landing_url_prefix}`, even if you shop on another country's Amazon. It may look blank or like an error, but that page is the goal. Copy its full address from the address bar.
4. Paste it below straight away.

A device named "*your name*'s Home Assistant Parcels" then appears in your Amazon account under *Manage Your Content and Devices*. That is this integration. Removing it there signs Home Assistant out.

data_description.landing_url: The full web address you ended up on after signing in.

hand_off.title: Hand parcels to carrier integrations
hand_off.description: Amazon only knows what you ordered. When the carrier that delivers a parcel has its own integration here, Home Assistant can hand the parcel over to it: carrier integrations show more, such as the delivery window, the pickup point and the full history. The parcel then shows up under that carrier instead of here.

data_description.hand_off: Parcels from carriers without an integration set up stay here.

error.invalid_url: That address does not contain a sign-in code. Copy the full address of the page you ended up on after signing in.
error.sign_in_failed: Amazon did not accept that sign-in. Open a fresh sign-in link and complete the sign-in in one go.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Amazon. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: That Amazon account is already set up for this country.
abort.wrong_account: That is a different Amazon account than the one this entry was set up with. Sign in with the original account, or add the other account as a new entry.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

carrier_not_set_up.title: {carrier} is not set up
carrier_not_set_up.description: Amazon parcels delivered by {carrier} can be handed to the {carrier} integration, which shows more than Amazon does, such as the delivery window and the full history. Until it is set up they stay listed here. See [the {carrier} page]({url}) to add it, or turn off handing off in the Amazon options.
